name: Frances Slocum State Park
hero_alt: Completed pool facility at Frances Slocum State Park
paragraphs: Frances Slocum State Park's public pool facility required both site construction and specialized mechanical work, and our team handled both. We built out the pool's mechanical and pump room — filtration systems, piping, and equipment housing — that keeps the facility running throughout the swim season.

With the mechanical systems in place and the surrounding pool deck and grounds finished, the park's pool complex — complete with water slide and lifeguard stations — is back in service for park visitors across Luzerne County.
